The ¹H NMR shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two sets of 2H), a methoxy singlet, and two aliphatic CH₂ triplets, consistent with a para‑methoxy phenylpropionamide. The SMILES “COc1ccc(cc1)CCC(=O)N” fits the formula and NMR data and has been validated.</thought>
